description: This Java source file implements the Hibernate-based Data Access Object (DAO) for managing MedicationDispense entities in the OpenMRS medical record system. It provides CRUD operations and query methods for retrieving MedicationDispense instances based on various criteria.

classes.name: HibernateMedicationDispenseDAO
classes.description: Implements the MedicationDispenseDAO interface using Hibernate ORM for database interactions. Provides methods for retrieving, saving, and deleting MedicationDispense records based on various criteria.

methods.name: setSessionFactory
methods.description: Sets the Hibernate SessionFactory used for database operations.

methods.name: getMedicationDispense
methods.description: Retrieves a MedicationDispense entity by its ID.

methods.name: getMedicationDispenseByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a MedicationDispense entity by its UUID.

methods.name: getMedicationDispenseByCriteria
methods.description: Retrieves a list of MedicationDispense entities matching specified criteria, such as patient, encounter, drug order, and voided status.

methods.name: saveMedicationDispense
methods.description: Saves or updates a MedicationDispense entity in the database.

methods.name: deleteMedicationDispense
methods.description: Deletes a MedicationDispense entity from the database.
